CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   C. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)

   C. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily

12. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
